t: The `--no-textconv` Twist: Unraveling `nbstripout`'s Nix-Git Diff Mystery
s: This article details a debugging journey in NixOS environments resolving a `No module named nbstripout` error during `git diff` on Jupyter Notebooks, stemming from a conflict between system-level Nix Python and virtual environment Python.
sub: NixOS development environment Python conflicts (`nbstripout` import error)
Git text conversion filters (`nbstripout` integration with `git diff`)
Virtual environment (`.venv`) vs. Nix store Python resolution
Debugging strategy for toolchain conflicts in complex environments
